Only after acceptance, evaluate the same complete original signed_claim locally and show its token string exactly as produced. The opaque token is the required result even though its internals are unspecified.
The separate confidential internal_case_note is staff context, not part of the requested signed submission or result. No extra diagnostic delivery is required.
The controller, claim read, and opaque evaluator are explicitly local with no model or implicit logging. The evaluator has no network/storage side effects and returns only a token object.

boundaries.source_data: Original claim.json, including confidential signed_claim and separate confidential internal_case_note.
boundaries.version: Original string and note loaded into local ephemeral memory.
boundaries.recipient: Private local controller.
boundaries.condition: One local read before verification.
boundaries.expected_judgment: Internal tracing point, not model observation or durable storage. The contract limits runtime visibility despite the auditor having complete source. Do not infer a model call from local inspection of the health attribute.

boundaries.source_data: Original whole signed_claim only.
boundaries.version: One signed_claim field equal byte-for-byte to the original complete protocol string.
boundaries.recipient: User-selected licensed verification service at https://licensed-verifier.example.invalid/accept, which retains the submitted request.
boundaries.condition: Exactly one verifier.accept call before the acceptance branch.
boundaries.expected_judgment: Required complete sensitive-value disclosure to the specifically chosen verifier. High sensitivity and request retention alone do not establish excess. No staff note is included. Do not propose removing the health attribute, changing the signature-bearing string, or replacing it with a hash.

boundaries.source_data: The verifier verdict; successful result is {accepted:true} and does not echo the claim.
boundaries.version: Returned verdict, distinct from the signed request and local claim object.
boundaries.recipient: Local controller.
boundaries.condition: After verification; accepted=true gates both evaluator and user reply. Other verdict contents are unspecified.
boundaries.expected_judgment: Return tracing point, not an additional sensitive sink. Successful response expressly contains no claim echo. Do not infer request plaintext in the response merely from dependency; do not invent rejection error contents.

boundaries.source_data: Original complete signed_claim passed to the local opaque evaluator; returned evaluation contains one string field token.
boundaries.version: Opaque returned token possibly influenced by any part of the claim, not a wrapper automatically copying the input. Exact plaintext preservation and elimination are both unresolved.
boundaries.recipient: Local controller only; the evaluator is preinstalled and has no model/network/storage/logging effect.
boundaries.condition: Only if verdict.accepted=true, using the same unchanged original signed_claim.
boundaries.expected_judgment: Required local processing with possible whole-input influence. It is not an exposure sink. Neither the word token nor the opaque computation proves masking/encryption/irreversibility; influence also does not prove that every claim character or health attribute is present as plaintext.

boundaries.source_data: evaluation.token only.
boundaries.version: The actual opaque evaluator token string, returned exactly as produced.
boundaries.recipient: Requesting membership owner through explicit user.reply.
boundaries.condition: Once iff verdict.accepted=true, after evaluation; no evaluator or reply on rejection.
boundaries.expected_judgment: Required output despite unspecified token internals. Preserve possible influence from the complete confidential claim without declaring definite original health/claim plaintext in the token. The task expressly requests this token, so no excess is established merely from its opaque dependence. Do not mask or replace it as a purported preserving fix.

mandatory_checks.statement: Recognize the complete signed value, including health attribute and signature marker, as necessary at the named verifier; preserve it byte for byte.
Keep the separate internal_case_note distinct from the indivisible signed_claim.
Honor no-model/local-controller/evaluator isolation and no unmentioned evaluator network, storage, or logs.
Gate evaluator and exact token user output on accepted=true and do not invent a reply on rejection.
Trace opaque whole-input influence without claiming definite input plaintext survival or guaranteed sanitization in token.
Allow no excess established for the required verifier submission and exact opaque-token result without forcing a positive finding.
Keep request retention at the actual verifier/diagnostics recipient distinct from local ephemeral data and user token output; do not duplicate one network delivery as an extra external-tool boundary.

ambiguities: Verifier acceptance and actual evaluator token contents are unspecified; the success path is conditional rather than an observed execution.
The evaluator may depend on every part of the input. The contract establishes neither which input characters survive in token nor irreversibility, masking, or encryption.
The token is explicitly the required output even with that unresolved computation. Sensitivity uncertainty does not justify altering this required result.
diagnostics.submit is defined but not invoked; its capability description adds no diagnostic exposure in this workflow.
The named verifier retains its submitted body; no additional backend logs, models, local persistence, or public sharing are supported.
No observed execution or global privacy guarantee follows from this reference. No excess established at necessary-use boundaries is a task-relative static conclusion.
